name: io.github.tonyyang0504/printify-mcp
description: Printify (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, create_order, get_order. Every tool

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PRINTIFY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Printify personal access token (My profile > Connections) sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PRINTIFY_SHOP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Printify shop id (from GET /v1/shops.json); required by get_order and create_order, which are per shop.
